claim: A common human cis variant is associated with PMP22 alternative-first-exon-linked junction usage in independent adipose cohorts.
context: GTEx v11 subcutaneous adipose and independent TwinsUK adipose, eQTL Catalogue release7 QTD000538. Bulk adipose and normalized intron excision, not Schwann cells or nascent transcription.
baseline_model: No same-direction association at the same variant and exact junction in TwinsUK. The GTEx signal could reflect cohort-specific cell mixture, technical processing or false discovery.
discovery_sources: GENCODE v47 exact exon boundary annotation
validation_sources: eQTL Catalogue release7 QTS000029 TwinsUK adipose QTD000538 leafcutter, public all-tested summary statistics
prior_exposure: GTEx v11 discovery outcomes inspected; 10 significant variant pairs all share chr17:15260761:15265154 junction. GENCODE minus-strand first exon boundary at 15265154 and common downstream exon boundary at 15260761 match. TwinsUK metadata only inspected; neither gene permutation, credible sets nor all-pairs outcomes retrieved/read yet. Hypothesis added after the fibroblast prediction, not an initial preregistered choice.
prediction: Exact GRCh38 chr17_15263668_T_C (rs231016), ALT C versus REF T, associates with lower usage of junction boundaries chr17:15260761:15265154 on the minus strand in TwinsUK adipose.
analysis_plan: Retrieve source all-pairs range for this exact variant, the whole-gene permutation row and explicit feature metadata. Match exact intron boundary coordinates, not cluster labels (which are cohort-specific). Confirm interval conventions; retain all plausible matches and do not silently shift coordinates. Check eligible feature/variant, source beta/se/p, allele count, study n, sample relatedness handling and covariates. Compute normal approximate 95% CI beta +/- 1.96*se only on compatible model. No new fine mapping or colocalization without LD/full harmonized statistics.
success_rule: Same allele and exact eligible junction, negative beta and two-sided source p < 0.025 (conservative additional screen threshold). This supports cross-cohort junction association, not promoter initiation or causality.
failure_rule: A significant positive beta contradicts direction; non-significance is non-replication rather than equivalence. Absent exact feature/variant or uncertified coordinate/allele mapping is untestable, not rescued by another splice event or gene-level eQTL.
confounder_checks: TwinsUK independent of GTEx; GTEx releases and Catalogue reanalysis of GTEx not counted
Verify handling of twin relatedness in reprocessed cohort; no manufactured donor independence
Bulk adipose cell composition and RNA processing versus promoter-use explanations
Do not compare normalized effect sizes as initiation magnitudes
Ten GTEx variants not ten independent loci; preserve LD ambiguity
selection_and_multiplicity: Exploratory cross-tissue discovery used source tissue-specific q-values. One additional outcome-unseen test at alpha .025. Original fibroblast prediction remains reported regardless of result; this is not its rescue and no global confirmatory family claim is made.
